passages.heading: Risk factors
passages.text: Our business involves numerous risks and uncertainties, including but not limited to the material risks described below. This section should be read in conjunction with all the other information in this Annual Report on Form 10-K and our other filings with the SEC. If any of these risks materialize from time to time, then our business, reputation, financial condition, operating results, and growth prospects could be materially and adversely affected. In such an event, the trading price of our common stock could decline, and you could lose all or part of your investment in our common stock. Additional risks, trends and uncertainties may arise that could also harm our business, reputation, financial condition, operating results, and growth prospects. Our past financial performance should not be considered to be a reliable indicator of future performance, and investors should not use historical trends to anticipate results or trends in future periods. These risks include those related to forward-looking statements and our actual results may differ substantially from those discussed in these forward-looking statements. Risk Factors Summary The following summary description sets forth an overview of the material risks we are exposed to in the normal course of our business activities. The summary does not purport to be complete and is qualified in its entirety by reference to the full risk factor discussion immediately following this summary description. We encourage you to read the full risk factor discussion carefully. Our revenue and expenses are difficult to predict, have varied significantly in the past, and could fluctuate significantly in the future due to numerous risks and uncertainties, many of which are beyond our control. As a result, we may not be profitable on a quarterly or annual basis. Our business, results of operations and financial condition, as well as your investment in our common stock, could be materially and adversely affected by any of the following material risks: • our dependence on the markets in Asia for our customer base, which may expose us to political, cultural, regulatory, economic, foreign currency and operational risks; • inherent risks associated with the operation in China, which could increase product costs or cause a delay in product shipments; • changes in general economic conditions in the countries where our products are sold or used, particularly those in China; • the impact of extensive Chinese government regulations, reduction or elimination of incentives, and uncertainties with respect to China’s legal system, on us and our manufacturing partners and suppliers; • changes in international trade policy, such as tariffs on imports of foreign goods and regulations restricting the export of goods and services, between the U.S. and China or other countries; • political and other risks in Taiwan and Hong Kong due to their tense relationships with China; • fluctuations in the value of the U.S. Dollar relative to other currencies, including the Renminbi; • our reliance on key suppliers in China, which may expose us to political, cultural, regulatory, economic, foreign exchange, operational and capacity shorta

credit_strengths.text: Revenue and operating income have expanded steadily across the three-year trend, with the latest operating margin well above the sector median, evidencing pricing power and operating leverage in power-management semiconductors. This scale and profitability support internal cash generation without reliance on external funding.

Operating cash flow covers capital expenditure comfortably, leaving substantial free cash flow, while the current ratio sits far above the sector median and the Altman Z double-prime zone is Safe. Liquidity and cash conversion are therefore strong relative to semiconductor peers.

key_risks.text: The risk-factor passage highlights dependence on Asian markets, particularly China, with exposure to tariffs, export controls, regulatory changes, currency swings and supplier concentration. Such geopolitical and trade disruptions could raise product costs, delay shipments or reduce demand, pressuring revenue and margins that currently anchor credit quality.

No funded debt is tagged on the balance sheet, but the debt note is absent and interest expense is missing, so leverage, coverage and refinancing features cannot be verified. This data gap is material because it prevents confirmation that the capital structure carries no borrowing or maturity obligations.

debt_servicing_capacity.text: With no reported borrowings and a large cash balance, debt service appears comfortably covered by operating cash flow and free cash flow. The absence of interest expense data prevents a precise coverage calculation, but the cash generation profile suggests ample capacity to meet any modest obligations.

Free cash flow exceeds shareholder distributions, with dividends and buybacks absorbing only part of internally generated funds. This retained cash flow, combined with a current ratio well above the sector median, provides a strong buffer against cyclical semiconductor demand swings.

overall_credit_view.text: The issuer presents a strong credit profile, with high operating margins, robust cash flow and a liquid balance sheet. The absence of tagged debt suggests minimal leverage, though the missing debt note and interest expense limit confirmation. We view the indicative financial risk profile as low, subject to data verification.

Forward-looking credit quality depends on managing Asian market concentration and trade policy risks while sustaining cash generation. If revenue growth continues and capital allocation remains disciplined, leverage should stay low. However, any material debt-funded acquisition or shareholder return expansion could alter the risk profile.

credit_strengths.text: 於三年趨勢中，收入及經營溢利穩步擴張，最新經營利潤率遠高於行業中位數，印證電源管理半導體領域的定價能力及經營槓桿。此規模及盈利能力支持內部現金生成，無需依賴外部融資。
經營現金流輕鬆覆蓋資本開支，留下大量自由現金流，而流動比率遠高於行業中位數，Altman Z雙素區間為安全。因此，相對於半導體同業，流動性及現金轉換能力強勁。

key_risks.text: 風險因素章節強調對亞洲市場的依賴，尤其是中國，面臨關稅、出口管制、監管變動、匯率波動及供應商集中度風險。此等地緣政治及貿易中斷可能提高產品成本、延遲付運或減少需求，對目前支撐信貸質量的收入及利潤率構成壓力。
資產負債表上並無標記任何有資金支持的債務，但債務附註缺失，利息開支亦缺失，因此無法核實槓桿、覆蓋率及再融資特徵。此數據缺口屬重大，因其妨礙確認資本結構並無借款或到期責任。

debt_servicing_capacity.text: 由於並無報告借款且現金結餘龐大，債務償付似乎由經營現金流及自由現金流輕鬆覆蓋。利息開支數據缺失導致無法精確計算覆蓋率，但現金生成狀況顯示有充足能力應付任何溫和責任。
自由現金流超過股東分派，股息及回購僅吸收部分內部產生資金。此留存現金流，加上遠高於行業中位數的流動比率，為應對半導體週期性需求波動提供強大緩衝。

overall_credit_view.text: 發行人呈現強勁信貸狀況，經營利潤率高、現金流穩健及資產負債表流動性充足。並無標記債務顯示槓桿極低，惟債務附註及利息開支缺失限制確認。我們認為指示性財務風險狀況為低，有待數據核實。
前瞻性信貸質量取決於管理亞洲市場集中度及貿易政策風險，同時維持現金生成。若收入增長持續且資本配置保持紀律，槓桿應維持低位。然而，任何重大債務融資收購或股東回報擴張可能改變風險狀況。
